title: Twenty-Five Is a Quarter of a Hundred

steps.prompt: How many $25$s are in $100$? How many in $300$?

cards.title: Four quarters make a hundred
cards.body: Four $25$s make $100$, so $25$ is a quarter of $100$. To multiply by $25$, multiply by $100$ and then share by $4$: halve, then halve again. $12 \times 25$: $1200$, halve to $600$, halve to $300$.

steps.text: Share the $16$ by $4$ first: a quarter of $16$ is $4$.
Each $4$ lots of $25$ make $100$, so it is $4$ hundreds.

cards.title: A quarter of a number
cards.body: To find a quarter, halve and halve again: a quarter of $60$ is half of $30$, which is $15$.

prompts: Explain how $25$ and $100$ are linked, and how that helps with $\times 25$.
